registryBasis: Middlesbrough Council is evidenced as the local land-charges registry/procedure custodian and states that database/GIS mapping data is available by request. This is a local registry/procedure indication, not evidence that the council publishes an anonymous cadastral parcel API. HM Land Registry is the national cadastral/land-registration custodian for England and Wales and publishes the relevant INSPIRE polygon partition.

officialSources.observation: Official Middlesbrough Council page lists Local Land Charges register searches, and separately identifies database/GIS mapping data as available by application/request; no public parcel endpoint is exposed on the page.
HM Land Registry download page lists separate INSPIRE GML files by local authority, including Middlesbrough Borough Council, according to the indexed first-party page.
HM Land Registry describes INSPIRE polygons as indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties, with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, monthly publication, and GML delivery.
GOV.UK guidance confirms the HM Land Registry INSPIRE dataset covers England and Wales, contains indicative registered-property polygons, and is accessed as GML through the current service.

requests.outcome: Official council page returned. It documents local land-charges registry searches and says database/GIS mapping data is available by request; no anonymous cadastral parcel API was exposed.
Official HM Land Registry dataset documentation was available through indexed first-party content; it describes monthly GML INSPIRE polygon publication and the safe polygon identity concept.

Direct fetch redirected to the same URL and reached a Cloudflare challenge/redirect loop after cookies; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, or private token was attempted. Indexed first-party content confirms the Middlesbrough Borough Council GML entry, but no unchanged GML or bounded geometry response was obtained.
GOV.UK guidance returned and confirmed the current HM Land Registry service and GML access route.
